architecture_contract.model: modality-specific variational encoders and decoders plus a graph VAE and adversarial modality discriminator
architecture_contract.warning: The guidance graph is a training prior, not evidence of a learned causal regulatory edge. Graph vertices, weights, signs, genomic windows, and preprocessing must be frozen inside each training partition.

implementation.checkpoint_policy: No general upstream checkpoint is admitted. Train SCGLUE or PairedSCGLUE inside each outer donor fold and hash every local artifact.
implementation.pypi_warning: PyPI exposes scglue 0.4.0, not source tag 0.4.1. The 0.4.0 wheel must not be silently substituted for this frozen source identity.

inductive_inference_contract.allowed: encode_data may compute an RNA embedding for held rows without model fitting when features and configured transforms are frozen.
inductive_inference_contract.experimental_cross_decode: decode_data can map RNA embeddings through an ATAC decoder without held ATAC, but upstream labels it EXPERIMENTAL and defaults target library size to 1.0 and target batch to 0.
inductive_inference_contract.frozen_decoding_inputs: Any future RNA-to-ATAC lane must freeze target library size, target batch handling, graph, feature order, and output interpretation before evaluation.
inductive_inference_contract.held_row_training: No fit_SCGLUE, adopt_pretrained_model, feature selection, query fitting, cell-type supervision, or calibration on held or sealed rows.

input_contract.atac_input: assay-native ATAC peak matrix with a training-only feature inventory and an explicitly frozen probabilistic decoder/preprocessing recipe
input_contract.guidance_graph: training-only bipartite gene-peak prior aligned to GRCh38.p14 and GENCODE v49, with exact vertices, edges, weights, signs, window, and hash
input_contract.rna_input: assay-native RNA matrix with training-only HVG/representation and explicitly frozen NB/ZINB or other decoder recipe
input_contract.pairing_mechanism: PairedSCGLUE marks paired cells through matching obs_names when use_obs_names is enabled; those identifiers require a validated same-cell or same-nucleus join.

output_contract.common_embedding: encode_data posterior mean, 50 dimensions unless the common lane freezes another identical dimension
output_contract.current_profile_status: latent-only under the current RNA-conditioned ATAC capability registry
output_contract.experimental_profile: decode_data mean over the frozen ATAC feature inventory; it is not scoreable until a separate fixture and TaskSpec revision admit it.

safe_loading_contract.upstream_risk: Model.save and load_model use dill, which can execute code during deserialization.
safe_loading_contract.required_adapter: Export a project-controlled state_dict plus architecture, feature, graph, and preprocessing manifests; never load external or untrusted dill artifacts.

source_evidence: The exact GLUE v0.4.1 tag, source, license, project metadata, and PyPI release mismatch were inspected on 2026-08-22. No package, checkpoint, or serialized object was downloaded, installed, loaded, or trained.

task_fit.cell_state_mapping: Eligible in principle as a locally trained RNA inductive embedding plus common head after runtime and feature fixtures pass.
task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: Latent-only in the current registry. Experimental decode_data is not an active direct-profile candidate until separately admitted.
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: Ineligible standalone because scGLUE has no allele-specific sequence mechanism.
